Approved `paper-repo`#11 at head 79b0a4a. Still waiting on the four Arrhythmia jobs for #8.

I re-checked both rewritten H1 sentences against `results/tables/h1_contrast.csv`, and the counts match:
- **shap Kernel at small budgets:** the contrast is 45.2–89.9 points, mean Pearson is below 0.9 in 8 of 9 cells, and H1 holds only for the Pima MLP. This is as the revised text says.
- **Paired Kernel:** H1 holds in 29 of 84 cells and the decision-level condition alone in 72. The 84 excludes the nine smallest-budget cells; over all 93 cells it is 29 and 81. I flagged that the sentence should say "above the smallest budgets" or give 29 of 93, but I did not hold the approval on it.
- **Head of the PR:** it doesn't yet include the German MLP floor-b rows that are in `dev` 994534b. I said so in the review.

I'll post the large-d results in #8 when the jobs end, then post the final CPU-hour total and give #4 its last status update.
